# IMPERIA COLD WAR — Cold War: Yugoslavia 1970 national programme.
## Generated by Claude outputs/COLDWAR_YUG_generator (yug_build.py) from the approved design (claude/mdcw_yug_1970_focus_tree_design.md).
## Edit the generator or the design, not this file. Search for 'COLDWAR' to find every Cold War addition.

on_actions = {
	on_monthly_SER = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					original_tag = SER
					IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_initialized
					check_variable = { global.num_days > global.COLDWAR_YUG_month_next_day }
				}
				set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_YUG_month_next_day = global.num_days }
				add_to_variable = { global.COLDWAR_YUG_month_next_day = 25 }
				COLDWAR_YUG_monthly = yes
			}
		}
	}
	on_monthly = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_succession_wars_open
					COLDWAR_YUG_is_ex_yu_tag = yes
				}
				COLDWAR_YUG_exyu_monthly = yes
			}
		}
	}
	on_government_change = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { original_tag = SER has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_initialized }
				COLDWAR_YUG_update_party_programmes = yes
			}
		}
	}
	on_war_relation_added = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = SER
					SER = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_initialized }
					OR = { COLDWAR_YUG_is_ex_yu_tag = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_offer_partner FROM = { COLDWAR_YUG_is_ex_yu_tag = yes } FROM = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_offer_partner } }
				}
				SER = { COLDWAR_YUG_deals_check = yes }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_long_war_active
					COLDWAR_YUG_is_ex_yu_tag = yes
					FROM = { COLDWAR_YUG_is_ex_yu_tag = yes }
				}
				if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_long_war } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_long_war }
				COLDWAR_YUG_refresh_surrender_cap = yes
				FROM = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_long_war } } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_YUG.70 } } }
			}
		}
	}
}
